reference_boundary: OpenAI/Codex source docs are citation metadata and governance references only. This manifest promotes platform-neutral ADK structured-output contracts and must not enable hosted models, API-backed runners, external runtimes, user-directory writes, or compatibility defaults.

contracts.refusal_handling: If the requested task cannot fit the schema, return blocked with a reason instead of inventing fields.
drift_controls: schema and template changes must be reviewed together
CI must fail when required fields or enum values disappear
Markdown summaries must be generated from structured fields when automation consumes them

contracts.refusal_handling: Completion gate returns needs-fix when command evidence cannot be represented.
drift_controls: evidence rows must preserve command exit status
negative or rejected path must be recorded for completion gates
human-readable reports cannot omit machine evidence fields

contracts.refusal_handling: When source evidence is missing, mark the handoff incomplete instead of fabricating continuity.
drift_controls: schema fields must map to context_state_contracts
raw evidence references must remain local paths or source URLs
excluded context must not re-enter active instructions

contracts.refusal_handling: If the task is too large for read-only lightweight planning, route to adk-task-breakdown or adk-planning-execution-loop.
drift_controls: read-only plan output must not imply files were changed
validation items must remain visible in the final plan
large or executable tasks must record escalation decision

contracts.refusal_handling: If local evidence is unavailable, return needs-fix with missing sources instead of inventing trends.
drift_controls: findings must cite local evidence or be marked low confidence
external search and external delivery remain disabled unless user-authorized
memory writes remain candidates until explicitly approved

contracts.refusal_handling: If archive evidence is unavailable, return needs-fix with missing paths instead of inventing metadata decisions.
drift_controls: new archive notes and existing archive governance remain separate intents
topic registry changes must cite the affected archive paths
raw source evidence must remain reachable from generated notes

contracts.refusal_handling: If the repository state cannot be read safely, return blocked with the missing command or permission boundary.
drift_controls: known baseline drift must be separated from real remediation changes
subrepo worktree dirtiness must not be treated as root gitlink movement without evidence
cleanup actions must remain explicit and reviewable

contracts.refusal_handling: If hardware, signing or publishing access is missing, return needs-fix with the safe dry-run evidence that was available.
drift_controls: publish and delete actions require explicit user approval
OTA, SD, MCU and NAS artifacts must record version, checksum and destination
diagnostic expected codes and invoke_ret semantics must stay machine-readable

contracts.refusal_handling: CI review publishing is blocked when findings cannot be represented in the schema.
drift_controls: finding locations must map to parsed diff metadata
SCM publishing code must read schema fields instead of prose
untrusted PR isolation decision must be recorded before write actions

must_not: treat valid JSON as schema compliance
hide schema parse failure in prose
let prompt wording replace machine schema validation
